explanation: The statement concerns the library's own objects: `stdSimplexCoordMap`, `stdSimplexAffineSet` and the library-defined homeomorphism `stdSimplexCoordHomeomorph`. Mathlib has no `stdSimplexCoordMap`/`stdSimplexCoordHomeomorph`/`stdSimplexAffineSet` at all (Mathlib's `stdSimplex`/`SSet.stdSimplex` is an unrelated notion), and there is no `IsClosedEmbedding` result about a standard simplex coordinate map. The only Mathlib ingredients are the generic lemmas `IsClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal` (Mathlib/Topology/Constructions.lean:402) and `Homeomorph.isClosedEmbedding`, which are applied to library-specific closedness and homeomorphism facts (`isClosed_stdSimplexAffineSet`, `stdSimplexCoordHomeomorph`); deriving the statement therefore requires the library's own development, not just instantiation of a single Mathlib declaration. So no duplicate and no Mathlib special case was found.
